name: Calm
description: Branded gradient hero and colored showcase headers over a calm, spacious full-width reading layout.
content:
## Calm

A confident, brand-forward template: a gradient hero band, colored showcase and card headers, and a full-width three-pane shell (nav · content · toc). Plus Jakarta Sans headings pair with an Inter body and JetBrains Mono for code.

### Highlights

- **Full-width three-pane layout** — the content column breathes
- **Gradient chrome** derived from `--base-accent-color`, so it re-tints per doc_set
- **Colored showcase / card / table headers** for lively, scannable demos
- Dark mode included (`pa-mode-dark`)

### Usage

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/templates/calm/dist/calm.css">
```

Defaults to light. Switch with `pa-mode-light` / `pa-mode-dark` on `<html>`; auto-follows `prefers-color-scheme`.
author: KeenMate
